You are a meticulous technical recruiter specializing in elite engineering talent. Your task is to rank candidates with absolute precision based on a strict rubric. You must identify missing skills by name and apply mathematical deductions without bias. Return ONLY a valid JSON object.


Rank ALL candidates based on their fit for the job description.

SCORING PROCESS (MANDATORY STEPS):
  Step 1. Skill Audit: For EACH required skill, state if it's "Explicitly Present" or "Missing".
  Step 2. Deductions: List all pts (Missing skills -15, Exp gaps, Seniority, Domain).
  Step 3. Math: 100 - sum of deductions (Floor at 0).
  Step 4. Cap: Apply 70 or 40 ceilings if required (Missing skill -> Max 70, Mismatch -> Max 40).
  Step 5. MANDATORY DIFFERENTIATION: 
     - If two candidates have the same score OR a gap < 10 points, you MUST adjust.
     - Keep the better candidate at the higher score.
     - Decrease the lower candidate's score by 10 points (e.g., 70 and 70 becomes 70 and 60).
     - Use "Nice to Have" skills or Tenure to decide who is better.
     - Final scores MUST be separated by at least 10 points (100, 90, 80...).

SCORING RUBRIC:
  - Missing REQUIRED skill:                     -15 pts each
  - Under minimum experience:                  -10 pts per year short
  - Over max experience (1-3 yrs):             -10 pts total
  - Over max experience (3+ yrs):              -25 pts total
  - Seniority Violation (Staff/Principal):     -20 pts ALWAYS
  - Domain mismatch:                           -35 pts

ABSOLUTE CAPS:
  - Missing ANY required skill: final score MUST be <= 70.
  - Domain mismatch: final score MUST be <= 40.
  CEILING RULE: The cap is the MAXIMUM. If two candidates are capped at 70, you MUST score them 70 and 60 to maintain the gap.

NO INFERENCE RULE (STRICT):
  If a skill is not EXPLICITLY named, it is MISSING. 
  Prohibited words: "implies", "suggests", "assumed", "likely", "probably".

ABSOLUTE RULES (VAL_REJECTION CRITICAL):
  1. Scores strictly descending.
  2. MINIMUM GAP: 10 points between EVERY adjacent rank (e.g., 70, 60, 50).
  3. NO TIED SCORES.
  4. Total spread >= 20 points.

REASON FORMAT:
  "[Audit: <skill>: [P/M], ...]. [Deductions: <list>]. [Math: 100 - <sum> = <val>]. [Cap: MIN(<val>, <cap>) = <val2>]. [Diff: Tie-break adjustment if any]. [Summary: <brief overview>]."

Example:
Candidate A and B both hit 70 cap.
A has more 'Nice to Have' skills.
A Reason: "... [Cap: MIN(85, 70) = 70]. [Diff: None]. [Summary: ...]"
B Reason: "... [Cap: MIN(80, 70) = 70]. [Diff: -10 to break tie with A]. [Summary: ...]"
Scores: {"A": 70, "B": 60}

{
  "reasons": { ... },
  "scores": {"A": 70, "B": 60, "C": 50},
  "ranking": ["A", "B", "C"]
}

JOB DESCRIPTION:
ApexTechnologies builds high-performance analytics platforms for financial services firms. As a Junior Data Engineer, you will own the ingestion and transformation pipelines that fuel our client-facing dashboards. You will work closely with senior staff to maintain data integrity and optimize storage costs while learning to manage complex analytical workloads. Responsibilities include: developing complex SQL queries to transform raw data into structured reporting tables for business users; utilizing Python to script automation tasks for our data orchestration workflows; implementing Flink for real-time stream processing to ensure low-latency data availability; and managing data storage using Iceberg to optimize query performance across our BigQuery and DuckDB environments. You will assist in debugging pipeline failures and documenting schema changes to support our growing data warehouse. We prioritize engineers who can write clean, maintainable code and communicate technical constraints effectively. Experience: 1-3 years. Nice to have: Trino, ETL/ELT, Fivetran.

Snowflake – Data Engineer

• Integrated Pandas-based data validation checks, reducing data errors by 75% before downstream consumption

Results-oriented Marketing Operations Specialist with 5 years of experience driving lead generation and pipeline growth. Expert at aligning cross-functional teams to optimize funnel performance and increase brand visibility across digital channels.

Marketing Operations Manager | HubSpot
• Architected automated nurture sequences in HubSpot that increased qualified lead conversion rates by 22% year-over-year.
• Managed Salesforce data integrity initiatives, reducing duplicate records by 40% and improving sales rep productivity.

Digital Marketing Lead | MongoDB
• Led SEO strategy overhaul, resulting in a 35% increase in organic traffic over 12 months.
• Leveraged Google Analytics to identify high-intent user segments, informing $500k in annual ad spend allocation.

Skills: HubSpot, Salesforce, SEO, Google Analytics, Lead Scoring, CRM Management, Email Marketing Automation.

Mid-level data engineer with 4 years of experience in cloud data platforms, ETL development, and real-time analytics. Focused on scalable data infrastructure and cross-functional collaboration.

Data Engineer
Vercel, 2020–Present
• Engineered BigQuery data models for product analytics, reducing report generation time by 70% across 15TB datasets
• Developed Apache Spark pipelines to process streaming logs, improving data freshness from hours to under 5 minutes
• Integrated Kafka with Spark Streaming, achieving 99.95% delivery reliability

Junior Data Engineer
Confluent, 2018–2020
• Automated daily data ingestion workflows using Python and Fivetran, cutting manual effort by 15 hours/week
• Enhanced data pipeline monitoring, reducing incident resolution time by 40%

JOB DESCRIPTION:
ForgeCloud builds secure, cloud-native identity platforms for enterprise SaaS applications. As a Mid-level Full Stack Engineer, you will design and implement core features across the frontend and backend, ensuring seamless integration and high performance. You own the development of API layers and database schemas that power customer-facing authentication workflows.

• Develop GraphQL APIs using Node.js and FastAPI to serve dynamic data needs across the platform
• Use Prisma to manage PostgreSQL schema migrations and optimize query performance for high-traffic endpoints
• Implement CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and deployment of full stack changes

Required skills: GraphQL, Prisma, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, CI/CD, Node.js
Nice-to-have: REST APIs, Next.js, Auth/OAuth
Experience: 3-6 years
Strict Seniority Ceiling: Do not apply if you exceed 7 years or hold a Staff or Principal title.

Candidate A:
Senior full stack engineer with 7 years of experience building scalable web applications across fintech and AI startups. Specialized in cloud-native solutions and secure API design.

At Scale AI, led migration from monolithic REST to GraphQL API, reducing payload sizes by 41% and improving frontend rendering speed. Integrated Auth0 and OAuth 2.0 flows for SSO across client portals, enhancing security compliance. Containerized services using Docker and deployed on AWS ECS with CI/CD via GitHub Actions.

At Retool, developed full-stack internal tools using Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL, enabling rapid UI iteration. Designed REST APIs to connect with 15+ third-party services, cutting integration time by 67%. Leveraged Docker for consistent staging environments, reducing deployment bugs by 23%.

Consistently improved system reliability and developer velocity through modular architecture and automated testing.

Skills: TypeScript, React, GraphQL, REST APIs, Docker, AWS, Prisma, Auth/OAuth, PostgreSQL

Candidate B:
Over 6 years of full stack engineering experience building high-performance platforms at data-driven companies like Amplitude and Cohere.

• Engineered a GraphQL gateway at Cohere to unify access to ML model endpoints, improving query efficiency by 41% and reducing client-side code by 30%. Used Prisma to manage PostgreSQL schema migrations and ensure data integrity.

• At Amplitude, built REST APIs for telemetry ingestion, handling 2M+ daily requests. Secured endpoints using OAuth 2.0 and JWT tokens. Deployed services on AWS Lambda with API Gateway, cutting infrastructure costs by 23% through auto-scaling optimizations.

• Containerized microservices using Docker and orchestrated via ECS, enabling reproducible deployments. Implemented CI/CD pipelines that reduced release cycles from weekly to daily.

• Collaborated with frontend teams using React to deliver dynamic dashboards. Integrated Auth0 for role-based access control across customer workspaces.

Deep expertise in AWS, Docker, GraphQL, REST APIs, Prisma, and Auth/OAuth.

Full stack developer with 8 years of experience creating high-performance web applications using modern JavaScript stacks and API-first development practices.

Senior Software Engineer | LaunchDarkly | 2020–Present
- Developed 10+ GraphQL APIs using Prisma and Node.js, reducing frontend data-fetching complexity by 60% and improving response times by 35%.
- Containerized 8 microservices with Docker, enabling consistent deployments across environments and reducing CI/CD failures by 70%.

Software Engineer | Twilio | 2016–2020
- Built RESTful APIs supporting real-time communication features, serving over 1M users monthly with 99.95% availability.
- Improved application performance by 50% through query optimization and Next.js server-side rendering.

Candidate D:
Experienced software engineer with 7 years in cloud-based application development, emphasizing security, scalability, and DevOps integration.

- Deployed and managed 10+ containerized services using Docker, reducing deployment inconsistencies by 70% and accelerating CI/CD cycles by 50%.
- Developed and secured REST APIs using FastAPI and Node.js, handling over 500K monthly requests with 99.9% reliability.
- Integrated AWS services including S3, Lambda, and API Gateway, lowering infrastructure costs by 40% and improving fault tolerance.
- Implemented OAuth 2.0 flows for third-party integrations, increasing user login success rates by 60% and reducing support tickets.
- Built dynamic UIs with Next.js, improving page load times by 35% and enhancing user engagement metrics.

VantaCloud provides secure, high-performance AI inference infrastructure for regulated industries. As a Staff ML Engineer, you will lead the architecture of low-latency model serving systems, driving innovation in quantization, GPU utilization, and retrieval-augmented workflows. You will define technical direction for model deployment and optimization across the platform.

• Implement model quantization techniques to reduce inference costs while maintaining accuracy for TensorFlow and PyTorch models
• Design and scale Triton Inference Server configurations to serve models efficiently on GPU clusters
• Write and optimize CUDA kernels to accelerate specific model operations and reduce end-to-end latency
• Build RAG pipelines using retrieval systems and LangChain to enhance LLM outputs with verified data sources

Required Skills: Quantization, Triton, CUDA, TorchServe, TensorFlow, RAG
Nice to Have: Model Serving, LangChain, PyTorch
Experience: 8-15 years

Candidate A:
With 8 years in ML engineering, I've architected model serving platforms at Stripe and Segment, focusing on performance, scalability, and developer experience. My work bridges research and production, ensuring models deliver real business impact.

• Scaled PyTorch model serving using Triton and CUDA optimizations, enabling 67% faster batch predictions for fraud detection systems
• Implemented a feature store with real-time ingestion from Kafka, reducing training-serving skew by 58%
• Integrated Weaviate as a vector database for semantic search, improving retrieval precision by 34% over baseline
• Led migration from TensorFlow to PyTorch across 50+ models, accelerating iteration speed by 40%

Passionate about robust MLOps and intelligent retrieval systems.

Skills: Triton, CUDA, Model Serving, PyTorch, Weaviate, Feature Stores, TensorFlow, BentoML, Vector DBs

Candidate B:
Senior ML Engineer with 7 years of experience building high-performance inference systems and scalable deep learning pipelines. Focused on optimizing model deployment and serving for LLMs and vision models in production environments.

• At Airbnb, led the optimization of PyTorch-based vision models using CUDA kernels, reducing inference latency by 42% and cutting GPU costs by $280K annually.
• Deployed 15+ LLMs using vLLM and BentoML, enabling low-latency model serving for customer support chatbots with 99.95% uptime.
• Fine-tuned domain-specific LLMs on 10TB+ datasets, improving downstream task accuracy by 27% and reducing hallucinations by 38%.
• Integrated Weaviate as a vector backend for real-time semantic search, handling 2.1M queries/day with <50ms p95 latency.

Candidate C:
Principal ML Engineer with 20 years of experience in AI systems, having led teams at Hugging Face, Elastic, and Shopify. Focused on high-performance inference, feature engineering, and semantic retrieval.

• Architected a Triton-powered serving platform with custom CUDA operators, achieving 7x speedup in LLM inference and saving $1.8M in annual cloud costs.
• Designed and deployed a real-time Feature Store at Elastic used by 40+ ML models, reducing data pipeline errors by 80% and accelerating training cycles by 50%.
• Led integration of Weaviate and Pinecone for enterprise RAG systems, improving retrieval relevance by 45% and supporting 100M+ vector queries/month.
• Built scalable PyTorch and TensorFlow model pipelines using TorchServe, handling 25K+ RPS with 99.98% availability.
• Mentored 16 engineers and chaired ML architecture council, driving standards for model versioning, monitoring, and serving.

Deep expertise in CUDA, Model Serving, and vector search. Extensive leadership in scalable ML infrastructure.

As a Mid-level Backend Engineer, you will contribute to building and maintaining core API services that integrate with customer systems and support mission-critical business processes. You will work across the backend stack to enhance reliability, performance, and feature velocity.

- Develop and maintain REST APIs using Django and FastAPI to support internal and external integrations
- Refactor monolithic components into scalable Java-based microservices with clear service boundaries and contracts
- Implement distributed locking and coordination mechanisms to ensure data consistency across services
- Collaborate on system design for high-availability services that operate across multiple availability zones

Required skills: Distributed Systems, REST APIs, Django, Java, FastAPI, Microservices
